pairs.subject: eval-harness
pairs.evidence: lib/articles/trial/verdict.ts:369 computeVerdict calls a trial challenged or upheld when the delta clears the preregistered band, and never compares that delta with the arms' within-condition SD, which it computes and only reports; so an order can be published that sits inside one SD of run-to-run noise.

techniques.evidence: lib/articles/trial/verdict.ts:369 The order is decided by delta > minEffect band only. sampleSd is computed per arm but never gates the verdict, so a two-arm order can be published inside one SD of the arms' own spread.

lib/articles/trial/registryRecord.ts:119 There is exactly one optimized metric with a direction, and every other metric is a threshold guard. An arm that fails a guard cannot win (verdict.ts:335 failedGuards).
lib/articles/trial/store.ts:236 The prereg is sealed by sha256. Exec and close refuse a prereg changed since the seal, so the exam cannot change under a stable trial id.

lib/articles/trial/registryRecord.ts:135 Every measured command after the seal is printed in the published record, so the attempt count travels with the number. Pilots are counted separately (line 140).
lib/articles/trial/verdict.ts:362 The model-call and wall budgets are declared and sealed before measurement. Overspending voids the trial instead of producing a result.
lib/articles/trial/verdict.ts:156 N is declared before the run with a floor of 3, and an arm short of n voids the trial (line 361). The aggregation rule is the mean, declared in the header contract.
lib/articles/trial/verdict.ts:357 A failed control or a short arm is attributed to the protocol layer (void, plus a registry lead at store.ts:775), not counted against either arm.

lib/articles/trial/store.ts:21 The arms are the techniques under test, not agents with a shell. The agent that writes results.json is the experimenter, a surface the code names openly; see registryProposal.

pairs.registryProposal: candidate-write-access lists the candidate's write surfaces, but it has no row for an experimenter-agent that frames the prereg, builds the harness, and itself writes the results file the verdict computes from. A sha256 seal plus an exec log (store.ts:17-21) catches drift but not fabrication. The technique could say what a harness must assert when the measurer, not the candidate, holds the pen.
